verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.01 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2018 (90% interval −0.02 to +0.03). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 8 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.15). Counted by gap size instead, 4 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.08). But: only 19 clear observation periods before the event (need 20).
reasons: only 19 clear observation periods before the event (need 20)

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
